title: Usage analytics
subtitle: Long-term statistics: kept {{hourly}} days by hour and {{daily}} days by day (adjust in <settings>Settings › Data retention</settings>)
zoneNote: Times are shown in the statistics time zone ({{zone}}).

chart.unavailable: The chart could not be drawn in this browser.

toolbar.deploymentNotForGpu: GPU utilization is not filtered by deployment; use the node and model filters

state.emptyHint: Statistics start to accumulate after the upgrade that introduced them; try a later range or a different filter.

backfill.label: Filled in from the request log
backfill.usage: The shaded part was filled in once from the per-request log: it may contain sampled estimates and does not include /v1/messages or /v1/responses requests. The rest is counted live over every request, without sampling.
backfill.quality: The shaded part was filled in once from the per-request log and may contain sampled estimates. The rest is counted live over every request, without sampling.

usage.keyPrefixMissing: The API token {{prefix}} has no usage in this range, so the list is not filtered. Try a longer range.

cards.hitRate: Hit rate {{rate}} (of requests that reported it)
cards.uncachedTip: Input tokens minus cache hits. Requests that did not report a cache figure are counted here as well, so this is an upper bound when some did not report.
cards.uncachedUnreported: Includes {{tokens}} from requests that reported no cache figure
cards.noUsageTip: Errors, clients that left early, or requests whose usage the gateway does not read yet. Their tokens are not counted.

chart.metaIn: Input and output differ greatly in size, so they are shown on separate charts.
chart.metaOut: Switch to Input to see the input side.

table.title: Details
table.hint: Click a header to sort; expand a row for the next level

cards.successTip: (Requests - errors - interrupted connections) / requests. A client leaving or a length cut is not counted as a failure.
cards.ttft: Time to first token P50 / P95
cards.ttftTip: From receiving the request to the first token of a streamed reply. Percentiles are estimated from a histogram (about 10% error), so merged hours or days are approximate.

chart.ttftTitle: Time to first token P50 / P95 ({{granularity}})
chart.ttftAria: Time to first token over time
chart.metaAll: Completed requests dominate, so abnormal outcomes are thin here; switch to Abnormal only to see them.
chart.metaBad: Completed requests are hidden to show when the abnormal ones happened.

quality.foot: Success rate = (requests - errors - interrupted) / requests. Percentiles are merged from hourly histograms and approximate.

filters.labelsHint: Filter by the labels nodes carry now (values of one key are alternatives, different keys must all hold); a deleted node has no labels and is left out

tooMany.hint: Too many cards to show one by one. Filter by node label or card model above, or group by card model or node.

cards.idleSub: Average utilization < {{threshold}}% · {{measured}} of {{total}} cards sampled; {{missing}} without utilization samples
cards.idleTip: Cards whose average utilization over the range is below {{threshold}}%: both cards given to a deployment that gets little traffic and cards given to none.
cards.idleNeedsDetail: Counted once filtered to at most {{limit}} cards

title.mem: Memory heat map ({{granularity}}, mean memory used)

chart.extremes: {{total}} nodes; the heat map shows the {{half}} with the highest and the {{half}} with the lowest {{metric}}. Filter by node label to see the others.

table.hint: Click a header to sort; tinted rows average below {{threshold}}% utilization

gpus.foot: Utilization, memory, power and temperature are the means and peaks of the samples in each bucket, then over the range.
gpus.summaryNote: This range covers {{count}} cards; past {{limit}} they are shown by card model or node. Filter by node label or card model to at most {{limit}} to see each card.

cards.hoursTip: GPU hours = cards held × hours. A dGPU counts by its share: half a card for one hour is 0.5.
cards.allocationTip: Allocated GPU hours / schedulable GPU hours of the cluster's cards in the range, whatever the deployment filter.
cards.perMillion: GPU hours per million output tokens

chart.title: GPU hours by deployment ({{granularity}})
chart.aria: GPU hours by deployment over time

table.title: By deployment
table.hint: Click a header to sort. Token figures are the whole deployment's.
table.perMillionOutput: GPU hours per million output tokens

gpuTime.foot: The fewer GPU hours per million tokens, the more the same cards produce; deployments without traffic show a dash.
